Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"imjdesign" <imjd...@enterprise.net> wrote:
> Quick check : Does the Psyche 'begin a new combat' effect
> trigger the Raptor card discard for a 2nd, 3rd etc etc
> time ?

Yes. The opposing minion's controller's hand size is restored
after the first combat ends (so she draws back up to her
hand size), then it is reduced again in the second combat (so
she discards down to her new hand size again).
